Gold is up 75% over 12 months and up 11.5% in the last month, which fits January 2026, when gold spiked before a sharp drop at the end of the month. The 12m drawdown of -10.3% suggests the snapshot is after a peak, so possibly end of January or February.

Fed funds effective was about 3.64% in December 2025, January 2026 and February 2026. Gold's 1m gain of +11.5% with a 3m gain of +22.6% fits January 2026, since gold rose from about 4,320 to about 4,900 (+13%). The 12m drawdown of -10.3% would reflect the late-January crash from about 5,400 to 4,900. Emerging-market equity +7.7% in one month also fits January 2026. CPI of 2.65% fits too, since January CPI came in at 2.4%, and December CPI was 2.7%. I'll go with January 2026.
